module_summary: 1G Ethernet MAC wrapper placing dual-clock AXI-Stream FIFOs between the logic-clock user side and a GMII MAC, with toggle synchronizers bringing MAC error pulses into the logic domain.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tdata
anchors.why: User transmit payload written into the TX async FIFO.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Transmit stream valid into TX FIFO slave port.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tready
anchors.why: TX FIFO backpressure ready to the user transmit stream.

anchors.name: rx_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Received payload read out of the RX async FIFO.

anchors.name: rx_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Receive stream valid from RX FIFO master port.

anchors.name: rx_axis_tready
anchors.why: User ready draining the RX FIFO.

anchors.name: gmii_rxd
anchors.why: GMII receive data bus into the MAC receiver.

anchors.name: gmii_txd
anchors.why: GMII transmit data bus driven by the MAC transmitter.

anchors.name: tx_fifo_axis_tdata
anchors.why: TX FIFO output stream in tx_clk domain feeding the MAC.

anchors.name: rx_fifo_axis_tdata
anchors.why: MAC receive stream in rx_clk domain feeding the RX FIFO.

anchors.name: tx_error_underflow
anchors.why: Underflow pulse recovered in logic domain from toggle synchronizer.

anchors.name: rx_error_bad_frame
anchors.why: Bad-frame pulse recovered in logic domain from RX toggle synchronizer.

anchors.name: rx_error_bad_fcs
anchors.why: Bad-FCS pulse recovered from RX toggle synchronizer bit 1.

anchors.name: tx_sync_reg_1
anchors.why: tx_clk toggle register capturing underflow events for CDC chain.

anchors.name: rx_sync_reg_1
anchors.why: rx_clk toggle register capturing bad frame/FCS events for CDC chain.

anchors.name: tx_fifo_overflow
anchors.why: TX FIFO overflow status from slave side.

anchors.name: rx_fifo_overflow
anchors.why: RX FIFO overflow status from master side.

anchors.name: cfg_ifg
anchors.why: Inter-frame gap configuration passed to MAC transmitter.

groups.description: GMII MAC converting AXI stream to GMII and back.
